nom: Clinique Acne Solutions Acne + Line Correcting Serum

avis.titre: Clinique products are effective and gentle
avis.texte: I use it by the corners of my mouth where I break out occasionally and have wrinkles.. It is the perfect solution.

Ive been using this prouduct for a couple days now and I've definitely been seeing improvement in my skin, along with clearing some break outs that I had before using this product. The best way to use this product is to apply hyaluronic acid, moisturizer, then sun screen after applying serum. Chefs kiss 🤌🏽🤌🏽.
I struggle with adult acne and swear by Clinique's acne line and was excited for this product. It is a nice light formula but unfortunately, I broke out with each use.
I love this keeps me a clean look fresher face every time I applied it before my makeup

I used at night and during day used acne solutions all over clearing treatment. My face was so clean. Love my clinique products. They dont work over night so stop given one stars snd bold letters lol like children.
This was gave to me by my sister and when i used it, it got rid of my acne and prevented breakouts
I have been using this product everyday for over 2 months and I haven't seen any difference at all. Waste of money!

Works great at smoothing the skin's surface and softening wrinkles. It helps with occasional adult acne as well. I've used this stuff for a year now and have tried other things in the past, but this product is my favorite.

avis.titre: Workers just trying to get sales
avis.texte: I repeatedly said I was really picky with my skin care as I have extremely sensitive and acne prone skin. The worker pushed this on me. I go home and see the reviews all say the worker pushed it on them too I use it for a week and my acne flares up.
Buying it again as I love how it contributes to my clear skin. I use it before I roll my face.

I like this product but the opaque bottle disguises the fact that there is less than 1 ounce of the serum in the bottle. So we are not getting what we are paying for and this has been the case for years with this product. Some one needs to call Clinique out on this. Real rip off.

avis.titre: ! DO NOT BUY, I REPEAT DO. NOT. BUY !
avis.texte: I was suggested this product in store for my acne. As soon as I put this product on my face it felt tacky but I let it slide. 2 weeks pass NO RESULTS, NO IMPROVEMENT, I let more time pass convinced myself to try it again. But it did ABSOLUTELY NOTHING. This product costs so much for it to not work. I still am convincing myself to use this since it costed me a lot.

I started getting breakouts in my late 30's after quitting my birth control, and I've tried SO many products. This is the best thing I've found so far. There was a noticeable improvement after using this for about 2-3 weeks. I still get some breakouts, but it's much improved.

I am a 42-year-old who just recently started battling acne for the first time ever; on top of that, my skin is aging, so I feel like I am battling two things at once. My friends call me "crunchy" since I prefer to use organic brands like Juice Beauty or Andalou Naturals, but my usual go-to acne products were not helping my most recent flare-up of pimples. I decided to ignore ingredients for once and try something new and I was pleasantly surprised to find a product that tackles both fine lines and acne at the same time. I bought it without batting an eye, despite the hefty price tag. The first night I used it, it did seem to help with acne and my skin felt like oily than it had; however, I did notice my skin seemed red and agitated. It was not anything awful like breaking out in a rash or hives, just not happy skin. After my third or fourth night of use, I noticed that it was having an effect on a mole I have had for at least 10 years. Y'all, I'm not even lying, but this product destroyed my mole. Now, I was not emotionally attached to this mole, but my mole never hurt anyone and it was fine just sitting there on my face. This product killed it -- it was like it ate it off of my skin. Yes, I know that sounds disgusting, but that's literally what happened. After the 4th time and me noticing my mole dying, I stopped using the product altogether. It was too late to save my mole. (RIP mole) While I want something to kill my acne, I think it's a little too strong if it can do that
I tried this for a month but it only gave me more acne. I'm giving it 2 stars instead of one because it was non-drying.

avis.titre: Part of my daily skincare routine
avis.texte: I use this in the morning and at night after a moisture serum. My face looks clearer. I'm prone to hormonal acne.

I never really had an issue with acne, only during that time of the month. As soon as I hit 40 the acne is never ending. I love Clinique serums and wanted something for acne, pores, and lines. I love that this doesn't dry out my skin and is gentle. I'm buying a second bottle. I love it!!!
Wears well under makeup. Using with acne solutions foam cleanser and toner then this serum.

avis.titre: Again my go to For acne/oily skin!
avis.texte: Love this! Acne solutions by Clinique is amazing I love their stuff never failed me once!!!
This serum really helps manage and control my breakouts while also hydrating my skin!

I have been using this product for several weeks with consistency and I have had to get an acne facial because it is just not strong enough. I just get congestion "maskne" & I was hoping this would break down the build up on my chin & jaw line but no luck, like at all. Also too expensive.

I have big, painful chin zits that get worse during my time of the month. This stuff has cleared my acne within a month! I have tried so many other things but clinique's acne solutions doesn't dry out my skin. My skin now looks radiant. I have normal skin type (not oily or dry). After washing my face twice a day I use #2 clarifying lotion, acne + line correcting serum on my chin and forehead, the clinical clearing gel on zits, then finish with the dramatically different moisturizing gel. Its expensive but worth it!
I love clinic, but this did not work for me. It did literally nothing, and I used the entire bottle. Waste of money!

I've been a huge fan of Clinique products for a few years now. i was really excited to add this serum to my skincare routine but it made me break out 2x as much. I've used it for about 2 weeks to really give it a fighting chance, i followed the directions on the bottle (few drops twice a day) and it just didn't work even though I really wanted it to.

I used this product as directed on the bottle, twice a day. I was breaking out very bad and I noticed it has gotten worse with this product. And the bad news is that how much I payed for it to make my face look worse. I really had faith in it but I guess it just wasn't for me, even thought the skin analysis on the Ulta app recommended me this one.

avis.titre: Good serum for adult acne prone skin
avis.texte: One pump, day and night. Working well for my skin (adult acne prone skin). Lately, everywhere is out of stock. Please don't discontinue.

Let me start by saying I'm a loyal Clinique customer for over 15 years. I love all their products. I was a little disappointed by this one though. Acne and line correcting, sounded too good to be true! I found this serum did little for my acne. I even bought two bottles and used regularly hoping for results! I guess I just expected more for the money for this one.

I personally have been on the hunt for a product that clears my skin without leaving my skin super dry. This product is wonderful! The first month of use I definitely see improvements in my skin and not to mention feeling very hydrated. The only downside to this product is that it is expensive for the amount you get, but worth it for the results!

I love Clinique but they took it to a whole other level with this product. Most importantly— it's gentle for sensitive skin. I'm in my early 30s and became extremely dry and sensitive with breakouts. My skin hates me in my 30s. I tried literally everything and this was one of the only things that helped normalize my red flaky acne prone skin. It didn't take long to work either. I literally got a sample of it and it has already really improved.

If the breakouts happened in spots that acne tends to appear, it is most likely to be skin purging. It is when you try out a new product, and the pimple or acne that was on its way to becoming an actual pustule, sprouts up on your skin. If the acne happens to form in a different area than normal, then it is probably a breakout and you should probably consult a doctor and stop using the product.

I've suffered from Adult Acne for years. I took an oral acne medication in my late twenties but now in my early thirties I'm suffering from more minor breakouts. The Clinique Acne serum WORKS! I've tried prescription retinoids with antibiotics but they were too harsh for my skin for daily use. The Clinique serum's salicylic acid formula is much more gentle and can be used daily before applying makeup and products. My cystic acne gradually flattened out over the course of a week - I am SO happy and relieved that this works! I am hoping that the red marks will gradually fade away as well. Any advice for red marks is appreciated. Best of luck!

avis.titre: Are breakouts suppose to happen with this initially?
avis.texte: I'm using the 3 step acne solutions products and decided to add this item to my routine, but I started getting breakouts a few days after starting it, is that suppose to happen? Or should I stop using it? Also what can I use for dark spots caused by acne?

I've tried everything for my consistent acne and this worked for me. I use it in addition to an oil control moisturizer and some spot treatments. While I do get breakouts still sometimes, this has definitely made them less frequent. definitely recommend for its function. I don't like the price, however, and I think the design doesn't allow you to get everything in the bottle which sucks.

I so desperately wanted to like this product. I spent so much money on this to add it to my skincare routine - I have consistent acne. It did absolutely nothing for me. Nothing. Don't waste your money. Would return if I could, would give zero stars if I could.

I tried this product for over two weeks to help combat breakouts and new wrinkles that started to appear on my forehead. Although my skin did feel hydrated, I returned this product as I did not see any difference in my breakouts or the appearance of my wrinkles after two weeks.
I have been using this for about 3 months now, and I'm a big fan. I use a dime size amount after toning before any primer, spf, or foundation. Its a godsend for my oily but aging skin.
I was eager to try this, but after 3 weeks of use my skin was twice a bad. It's not definite that the serum is what made it worse, but for the price it did not make it better.

avis.titre: treat your skin! worth the money!
avis.texte: this is a pricey skin item but it is awesome because I have large pores and combination skin this is amazing after a few days my skin already looks and feels softer and my acne is going down in redness and size! this is a definite holy Grail as well as repurchasing item!

I've been using this for about a week and already notice a difference in my complexion. I'm 33 and don't have wrinkles-yet. Hopefully it will make a good/helpful preventative for the "fine lines". I think it's worth the money so far. My only complaint is that it takes a little bit to dry but when it dries it feels ok.

I got off birth control and I realized it must have been controlling my acne because it came back terribly! I was getting red, sore bumps on my forehead. This cleared me up completely in a couple weeks and overall made my entire face smooth and amazing. I was also using the acne face wash and toner. I use their age prevention moisturizer. I'm so in love. Thanks Clinique!
This product works great! I've only had it for a week and my face has cleared up. It's also supposed to help with wrinkles. A double win.
I used this product for a week and didn't see any difference in my skin but by the 2nd week it worked perfect. I've tried tons of products for my acne but nothing worked as good as this product.

I have been using this serum and I absolutely love it!! I noticed a difference in my acne in just two uses! I am 20 years old and just started getting adult acne unfortunately but this product has helped me dramatically! I love all of the Clinique acne treatments I would 10/10 recommend if Clinique is the brand that works for your skin.

My skin has the absolute perfect balance of moisture after adding this serum to my routine. I've struggled with hydration of my skin, as well as worsening wrinkles, and terrible cystic acne. After adding this serum, my skin feels perfect. Soft, not dry, not oily, all of my breakouts have lessened since starting the serum. I get nervous about using anything for anti-aging, with have acne, but this has made a world of a difference in my skin. So grateful that this product is available!

avis.titre: I've tried it all- This is what you NEED!!
avis.texte: Use the serum after you cleanse and exfoliate and follow with a moisturizer. It is absolutely amazing for severe adult acne. I've tried it all from low end to high end and I can honestly say it changed my life. The one and only treatment that worked for my severe acne. I went from having a face full of breakouts that looked like a bumpy rash to now completely clear skin. This serum is life changing. If you have extremely bad acne then this is the product for you.

I first got this serum as a sample when I destroyed my skin using expired make up! (I know, I know...) And it helped clear me up faster than what I was already trying! I have been dealing with moderate acne since my early teens and my skin looks better now than it has... ever! I'm 29 so the fact that this helps with fine lines is an amazing bonus for me! Not many products treat both! The dropper is wonderful! I use one drop on my forehead and two each cheek.
I have sensitive skin and have occasional breakouts. The salicylic acid in this product keeps that under control. I love it.
This has helped my adult acne and my acne scars. I have sensitive skin and had no issue with this.
I use this product in the morning, keeps my skin smooth and ready for moisturizer.

avis.titre: My absolue must have skin care product
avis.texte: I would like to start off by saying I have worked in the cosmetics field for 10 years. Because of this I have been fortunate to have access to many high end brands of skin care and makeup alike and I've tried it all, especially when it comes to targeted acne products. I have had acne since I was 13 (I am now 28) and this is, hands down, the absolute only product that has cleared my skin up and kept it clear. It does not dry out my skin at all, in fact it makes it so smooth and poreless. It has gotten rid of stubborn hormonal acne, bad eating and drinking habits acne ,and also opps I fell asleep without washing my face and now I have a breakout acne. I have gone through about 10 bottles of it and I always have a backup on hand, that's how much I trust and believe in this product! The fact that it's also full of peptides is a bonus because it has helped to keep my skin plump and youthful as well. It is a godsend. I praise Clinique for their skin care and always will!
I love this serum! I tried a sample of it and I fell in love! I am almost 30 and I still struggle with some acne and some fine lines and this has been a life saver!

avis.titre: My holy grail products to treat my acne
avis.texte: Quick back story on my skin: when I was like a teenager, I had pretty good skin, a pimple here and there, nothing too bad. But as I got into college to now (I'm 24) I've been more stressed, bad lifestyle choices, etc, my acne has been sooo bad, mostly around my chin/cheek area. So rn, my skin is combo/oily, and the warmer months always break me out, along with the time of the month and stuff. Ok now this product is amazing. I use this twice a day. So I cleanse my face first, use a toner, then I use this, small drop each on my chin, cheeks, forehead, and nose, then I finish with a mattifying moisturizer. And within a few days, I start to see the inflammation and redness of my acne start to go down as long as if I don't touch my face or try to pop things (which I have a bad habit of doing lol) but whenever I run out of this, my skin goes crazy, so it's def a staple in my routine, and I've been using this for about 4 months, and I just bought my second bottle. Hope my story helps you guys!

I don't normally like to spend a lot of money on a "new" product espically not knowning if it will actually work. I decided to give this one a chance. This is currently my 2nd bottle and i love it! I ran out of this bottle 2 months ago and have notice the acne coming back. I ran to the store and grab a bottle and started using it the same night. The next morning all my acne went away!! This is denfenity worth the money and i will keep repurchasing this time and time again!

avis.titre: I did buy this product again!
avis.texte: I use this product Acne Solutions Acne + Line Correcting Serum when I do my 3-step system once in the day and at night. I have found that it didn't take 4 weeks of use for me to see the results. After one week of use day and night I saw the acne that I had on my chin, corners of the mouth, and forehead reduced to thin air. LOL! I know it's hard to believe but it worked for me. So I brought another bottle as back up. I love using this as apart of my regular skincare. So glad that I tried it out.
Works great clearer skin form horrible acne but I started getting red bumps all over my face after about a month and it take them about a hr to go away

The skin consultant recommended this product to prevent acne , I got a huge pimple and I wanted to try anything to get rid of it . Should've just waited it out instead using this product !!! I only get breakouts sometimes .. I have clear skin . I used it at night the next day I woke up with huge pimples all in a row when I only had one ! So disappointed!!! Stay away !

avis.titre: Ive noticed results with this product.
avis.texte: I typically dont purchase high dollar products, but for the record it goes on smoothly, no oily afterlayer. Dries quickly and leaves my skin smooth. I have noticed that my skin looks even now and as well as the most affected areas are clearer. Pores are also minimal. Money well spent.

I am an adult with acne for the first time in my life. I have never had to deal with them before...ever...and have hated what has been happening to me. I have tried several things and this seems to work so far. I still have acne but it doesn't look as severe as it has. I do however have acne marks and purchased the dark spot product from Clinique but haven't used it yet since my acne is still so active. Again it does appear to be helping. I am hoping patience and a good regime will help. If anyone has any other suggestions please please post them!!
I was just using a retinol serum and using acne medication and since switching I only need to use the medication during pms when I get mountains on my face.

I was having trouble with adult acne and could not find anything that helped without drying out & Irritates my skin. With all the reviews and i went ahead and bought this. I've been using this for about 3 weeks and i must say its worth every penny!!! This has cleared my skin! I will be purchasing this product again and again.

avis.titre: LOVE this stuff!!! It's perfect and totally worth the money!
avis.texte: I have been struggling to find something for acne. THIS IS IT! So easy to use, doesn't bleach clothing, and very thin to apply! I have no cons!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This product is a bit pricey but I is totally worth it, highly recommend it.

I had extreme breakouts from an anti-ageing serum. I decided to trade that product in and get this one in hopes it would help the breakouts, and become a serum I can actually use. This is an amazing product. I haven't used it long enough to notice wrinkle-reduction, however, it cleared my skin right up and I've never seen my skin so free of any blemishes. It also seems to combat shine and oil. A+++
I started to have very small but many pustules on my face. Very disgusting! This has worked good on this problem.

I am getting ready for my wedding in two months, and stress plus the heat of South Texas has made my face break out much more than usual the last few months. Before switching out of my beloved Clinique 3-step system, I decided to give it one more go with this. I have only been using it for about 48 hours, but it really does what it says! 3 drops morning and night, rub it into my face and then follow up with moisturizer. My skin is already starting to even out and my small breakout is actually disappearing. I went to bed with a big, painful pimple and woke up to it being gone! I have to say I use the clinical clearing gel with this product, but I have never gotten these kinds of results with the gel alone. I didn't have any kind of pilling action, but I also followed it up with a light moisturizer. I am going to be optimistic about it helping with my worry lines, I don't really see a difference yet. Bottom line, this is going to make a difference if you suffer from adult acne.
I saw a difference after a couple of days. I am very happy with this!
This did not aggravate my skin but didn't do anything either. It was hard to rub into my skin while leaving a greasy and tacky film behind. After consistent nightly use, I saw no changes in my skin.

I used this as directed and it didn't do anything. It doesn't moisturize, it didn't help acne, it doesn't feel like anything. It's thin and a light whitish in color. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. I don't see any difference. I am almost done with a whole container and I will not be repurchasing.

Oh my word! This product has saved my skin! I would say I have moderate acne and I would go through the motions of just letting the current zit take its course, until I started using this. I received this in a deluxe sample size (which lasted forever!)I went a few days after my sample ran out and noticed I was having more breakouts then normal. It' was because I was not using this! I ran out and purchased the full size and skin is back to normal! The price point is in line with the rest of Clinique products, but this is worth every dollar!

I recently discovered the Clinique Acne Solutions line. I have been very pleased with all the products. I use this serum, along with their foaming face wash and lotion/toner. My skin hasn't been this clear in a long time!

I fell in love with this product and it will be a permanent staple in my beauty routine! It really helps calm my acne and reduce redness while making my overall skin look great. So many acne products are harsh and drying but not this one. Love!!!

I'm 32 and break out often in the worst way no matter how careful I am with my routine. I was very hesitant to purchase this item after describing how sensitive my dry skin reacts to new products. I am on week 3 and I have noticed a big difference! My skin looks and feels so clear! I haven't had a zit pop up in over a week.. Definitely planning on purchasing another one!

I'm over 30 with acne prone skin... Enough said. This definitely has helped hydrate my skin more but the jury is still out on if it clears up acne. I haven't seen as many cystic breakouts since I started using it so that's a positive. So far after about a week and a half I haven't decided if I'll buy another bottle.

avis.titre: A Dangerous Product--Use At Your Own Risk
avis.texte: The latest entrant in Clinique's Acne Solutions line, this product does nothing that it purports to do, while actually causing harm to the skin. It is supposed to help solve twin skin concerns: hormonal acne and signs of aging. Unbelievably, most of the positive reviews I've seen for this product were written by very young people who cannot possibly be concerned about aging skin! Far worse were the results I endured--large, burn-like welts, which in the past I'd experienced after using benzoyl peroxide-based products. Since this product contains salicylic acid (a tiny percentage), I thought it would be safe to use, Boy, was I wrong!

I really wanted to like this product but its not for me. I used daily for two weeks & it did more damage than good. I doubt this was the purging stage since i went back to another serum and my skin healed up literally overnight

I love Clinique serums, so I was really happy when they released a serum for acne. So far I'm pretty happy with the product. My chin acne has seemed to clear without any other spot medication. My acne is not bad, but it's nice to see it becoming even clearer. It also really nice that the product seems to work, but doesn't dry out my skin! It is very comfortable to wear and is not even a little oily. The only downside I notice is that the serum is a little hard to apply. It dries out very quickly and does not smooth over skin as easily as other serums do. To fix this, I damped my face a little before application, which makes it easy to apply. No big deal though. As long as I continue to see good results, I'll keep on buying this!
